notes: Dev ABox revision; the edited relation wife_of carries the subproperty wife_of ⊑ spouse_of (staging/literature_arts.RELATIONS.md). Mary Shelley's husband, Percy Bysshe Shelley, is held by every model; the edit swaps in F. Scott Fitzgerald (it need not be plausible: he was born 45 years after she died). Related near asks whether she was still the wife of Percy Bysshe Shelley, by functionality of wife_of (2026-11-12: it replaces the question about Fitzgerald's spouse, which relied on the presupposition that Fitzgerald married only once; the models did not hold that, and gave 'Zelda Sayre' for 'Zelda Fitzgerald'). Related far reaches Mary Shelley by a role the model holds separately (the author of Frankenstein; binding; reworded 2026-11-12 to 'which man', since two models answered with Mary Shelley herself) and asks the superproperty, a stored answer. Derived: two compositions with stored facts about Fitzgerald (nationality; poet or novelist), and a binding on the object side: 'the author of The Great Gatsby' stands for the edit's object, so the model has to connect the description to Fitzgerald, and the superproperty 'married to' carries the edit (task binding, derivation subproperty; it was labelled task answer before). Both writers married once, so spouse_of is functional for this pair. Unrelated near asks her mother, which the edit leaves alone. Round 3 (2026-11-13): related far reworded to 'Which man did the woman who wrote Frankenstein marry?' after all four models answered Mary Shelley herself.
